title: Incidence of Cracking or Popping of Floor Tiles in HDB Flats in Woodlands Town
what_it_is: Incidence of Cracking or Popping of Floor Tiles in HDB Flats in Woodlands Town

sections.label: HDB tile data and anecdote
sections.summary: HDB does not track data for blocks built over 15 years ago, though residents report over 50% of units had popped tiles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For the blocks in question, because they were built more than 15 years ago, HDB does not keep track of the data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
sentences.text: Anecdotally, from what I understand from residents, I have been told that over the course of 15 years, more than 50% of the units have had their tiles popped.

sections.label: Suggestion for one-off HDB grant
sections.summary: The speaker suggests HDB give residents a one-off grant to replace tiles themselves if it is a workmanship issue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
sentences.text: Because I think this issue will continue to arise and continue to come up, if it is a workmanship issue and rather than HDB incurring the cost of replacing it each time, my suggestion would be for HDB to give a one-off grant to the residents to replace at their own cost and their own choice of the type of tiles.

sections.label: HDB 15-year defects liability period
sections.summary: HDB's practice goes beyond developers' one to three-year Defects Liability Period, covering cases surfaced within 15 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Most developers would give a one-year Defects Liability Period (DLP), while others may give more, for example, three years of DLP, on a goodwill basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: HDB's practice goes way beyond that, to 15 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We do so for all such cases that are surfaced to our attention within the 15-year period, without us necessarily looking at the cost of it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As for the Member's suggestion, we take note of it.
